thread:
sarah: Quick sync — brought up quantized int8 reranker on docsearch-v2. dev ndcg@10 down ~0.8 pts, MRR up ~0.5 pts. suspicious, sharing eval logs.

omar: Can you paste the eval command + seed? Did you use the same negatives as the float run?

jit: BM25 negatives vs in-batch hard negatives can flip NDCG sensitivity. Also did we change tokenization/truncation?

sarah: eval-bot: run_id=rk-quant-int8-031; cmd: `./eval_rerank --model rerank-int8 --data datasets/docsearch-v2 --neg_strategy bm25 --seed 42 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr`

lina: We truncated docs to 600 tokens (was 800) for performance. That could remove context and hurt ndcg@10 for longer queries.

mel: Also note we injected synthetic adversarial negatives during training last week — that can shift the score distribution. Quantization can amplify calibration errors.

km: @sarah can you attach per-query delta distribution/histogram? A small mean can hide a heavy tail.

sarah: pasted quick stats: `median delta ndcg@10 = -0.002, mean = -0.008, 95th percentile tail = -0.12` — looks like most queries unchanged, small fraction large negative.

omar: Run bootstrap CI for the mean/median. And compute per-query correlation between ndcg delta and doc length / candidate set size. Up MRR + down NDCG often means top-1 improved but ranks 2..10 degraded.

lina: Proposed quick checklist:
- stratified eval by doc length (<=200, 200-600, >600)
- neg_strategy ablation: bm25 vs in-batch vs adversarial
- per-query bootstrap 95% CI
- exact preproc parity: float32 vs int8 on same bytes

sarah: I'll kick off those jobs. Aim: get first pass within 24h.

mel: If it's quantization noise, try asymmetric quantization or run PTQ fine-tune (1 epoch) and try temperature calibration on softmax. Also test layer-wise quant skip for final transformer blocks.

jit: Pseudo bootstrap snippet to run in eval harness:
```
for i in range(1000):
  sample = sample_with_replacement(queries)
  metric_i = mean(metric(sample))
ci = percentile(metric_i, [2.5, 97.5])
```
